newsitem.title: USA: Dentsply to acquire New Image.
newsitem.headline: Dentsply to acquire New Image.

text.p: Dentsply International Inc said Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire New Image Industries Inc for $2 a share in cash.
Under the deal, Dentsply will loan New Image up to $3 million to be used as working capital.
The acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, Dentsply said.
A total dollar value of the deal was not immediately available.
New Image, based in Carlsbad, Calif., designs, develops, manufactures and distributes intra-oral cameras and computer imaging systems and related software for the dental industry.
Dentsply designs, develops, manufactures and markets a variety of products for the dental market.
